0022600086.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Milwaukee Bucks visit the Washington Wizards. The Wizards won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 109-99 home win over the Bucks on January 29, 2026. Milwaukee is without Jericho Sims (day-to-day, undisclosed reason) and Nate Ament (day-to-day, ankle sprain), both game-time decisions, while Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (out, knee), Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip), and AJ Dybantsa (day-to-day, ankle sprain, game-time decision). ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Bucks a 35% chance to win.
